resolution.note: adopt installs a SessionStart hook (krn hook session); test/hook/session-start.test.ts runs adopt, hook session, hook stop and standards effect in a fresh adopted repo

title: An adopted fresh repository provably inherits the brain
body:
Why: Fable direction (overnight): the brain of best standards must provably reach every adopted repository; the public outside rows (t-bkbkmbd) give untuned adopted repos to prove it on.
Outcome: in an adopted public scratch repo (/mnt/storage/tmp/krn-outside-public/{php,npm,py} or a fresh clone of one), a Claude Code session start serves the standards block from the brain (src/hook/session-standards.ts), a seeded standards violation is taught at Stop (krn hook stop), and the lane exposures feed krn standards effect with at least one effect line; any gap is a KRN defect fixed with a regression test against the real receiver.
Proof: a test that runs the real hook entry points (krn hook ... with a captured payload) in an adopted fixture repo and asserts the standards block and the Stop teaching; plus one krn standards effect line from outside exposures recorded in the PR body.
